name: cure
description: Cure Consulting Group's private plugin marketplace — the product engineering skill library and tooling.

plugins.name: cure-product-engineering
plugins.description: Complete product engineering skill library — 106 skills (domain-organized), 41 agents (engineering, product, marketing, business, data, security), 4 personas (cross-domain engagement archetypes), 11 rules, 9 output styles, multi-layer hooks with agent auto-triggering, bundled stdlib Python tooling, MCP + LSP servers. Standards for Android, iOS, Web, Firebase, Python, Go, Rust, Docker, Terraform, and cloud infrastructure.

plugins.name: cure-tri-lane
plugins.description: Opt-in multi-vendor orchestration: Claude architect, Codex implementation and correctness lanes (codex exec), Antigravity system-review lane (agy) in read-only worktrees, and a fresh-context advisor. Uses existing ChatGPT and Google logins; independent of cure-product-engineering.

plugins.name: cure-policy-guard
plugins.description: Mod: refuses file writes that break a written Cure house rule unless you override; overrides are recorded.

plugins.name: cure-lane-verifier
plugins.description: Mod: attaches git's evidence to subagent and lane reports; flags a 'complete' with an empty branch.

plugins.name: cure-spend-band
plugins.description: Mod: today's GitHub Actions spend beside the spinner, a pace warning, and /spend.

plugins.name: cure-cache-band
plugins.description: Mod: prompt cache time left, hit rate and misses above the prompt; says what a cold next message re-caches. Adds /cache.

plugins.name: cure-image-viewer
plugins.description: Mod: draws the images you paste above the prompt until the turn that sent them ends.

plugins.name: cure-secret-scrub
plugins.description: Mod: redacts API keys, private keys, service account secrets, and tokens from Read, Grep, and Bash outputs. Adds /secret-scrub.

plugins.name: cure-llm-ledger
plugins.description: Mod: per-turn LLM token and dollar cost ledger attributed by repo, branch, and model. Adds /ledger.

plugins.name: cure-cite-check
plugins.description: Mod: verifies code line citations (file:line) in assistant answers against disk, flagging stale lines. Adds /cite-check.

plugins.name: cure-claim-guard
plugins.description: Mod: enforces multi-machine state file ownership rules in shared repos (DistrictZero state-targets.md). Adds /claims.

plugins.name: cure-ci-preview
plugins.description: Mod: pre-push GitHub Actions CI runner time and cost estimator. Warns when commits mix doc notes with code. Adds /ci-preview.

plugins.name: cure-agent-budget
plugins.description: Mod: enforces subagent fan-out concurrency caps and auto-routes read-only research subagents to cost-effective models. Adds /agents-budget.

plugins.name: cure-egress-guard
plugins.description: Mod: prevents unauthorized outbound data transmission to external AI vendor endpoints in sensitive repos (PHI, minors). Adds /egress-guard.

plugins.name: cure-rules-band
plugins.description: Mod: displays repository house rules and legal/architectural constraints in a HUD banner above the prompt. Adds /rules.

plugins.name: cure-handoff
plugins.description: Mod: drafts structured STATE.md handoff entries from git commits, branch status, and working tree diffs. Adds /handoff.

plugins.name: cure-lane-board
plugins.description: Mod: multi-lane dashboard for tri-lane worktrees, branches, live commits, and defect window status. Adds /lanes.
